idea-plugin.name: API First & Mocking Studio
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.9.0

  • New Tools menu actions: Start Mock Server (127.0.0.1 only) and Generate HTTP Client File.
  • Settings now take effect (timeout, redirects, history size, mock-server port); the unimplemented SSL option was removed.
  • cURL import tokenises like a shell and supports -u, --url, -XPOST, -I.
  • Mock data fixes: arrays, inline examples, OpenAPI 3.1 type arrays, recursive schemas; Swagger 2.0 files are converted.
  • GraphQL bodies built as proper JSON; code snippets escaped correctly; Postman folders and disabled headers handled.

2026.8.0

  • The plugin is now completely free — all features unlocked, no license needed.
  • Source code is now open source under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/JirakJ/api-first-mocking-studio

action.description: Serve sample responses for every operation of an OpenAPI/Swagger file on 127.0.0.1
Generate a JetBrains HTTP Client (.http) file from an OpenAPI/Swagger file
